runtimes.name: receiptsagent
runtimes.description: Receipts IDP pipeline: OCR, extractor and independent validator agents, Cedar-gated save or human review, with a model degradation ladder

runtimes.name: receiptschat
runtimes.description: Receipts chat assistant: multi-turn questions about a user's own expenses. Same code as the pipeline Runtime; a separate Runtime so chat sessions are evaluated apart from receipt sessions

evaluators.name: ReceiptsExtractionAccuracy
evaluators.description: Extraction accuracy: dollar gap on the total plus every other field against a labelled answer. Needs ground truth, so it runs on labelled data, not online

evaluators.name: ReceiptsRoutingOutcome
evaluators.description: Routing outcome: the validator's save-or-review call against a labelled answer, judged on the extraction it was shown. Needs ground truth

evaluators.name: ReceiptsThresholdControl
evaluators.description: Control monitor: anything at or above the Cedar limit saved automatically. Needs no labels, so it runs online

onlineEvalConfigs.name: ReceiptsLive
onlineEvalConfigs.description: Receipt pipeline, live: the Cedar threshold control monitor on every session

agentCoreGateways.name: ReceiptsGateway
agentCoreGateways.description: MCP Gateway for receipts tools: user profile, recent expenses, merchant lookup, save expense, human review

policyEngines.name: ReceiptsPolicyEngine
policyEngines.description: Cedar policy engine for receipts authorization — allow-all + selective deny on save-expense over a threshold (routes to human review)

policies.name: AllowAllTools
policies.description: Permit all tool calls on the receipts gateway for authenticated agents

policies.name: BlockExcessiveExpense
policies.description: Forbid SAVING an expense of $2,000 or more; the agent routes it to human_review instead. It compares total_cents, an integer: Cedar will not compare a decimal with a whole number, and the Gateway passes totals such as 15.9 or 1250.0 as decimals, which made the earlier `total >= 2000` error and deny every save. Guards, in order (Cedar && short-circuits): (1) `context has input`, so the statement is valid for actions with no input; (2) `!(context.input has reason)` scopes it to the save path (human_review requires reason), so the review fallback is never blocked; (3) `context.input has total` excludes the read tools; (4) a save without total_cents is denied (fail closed), else total_cents >= 200000.
policies.statement: forbid(principal, action, resource is AgentCore::Gateway) when { context has input && !(context.input has reason) && context.input has total && (!(context.input has total_cents) || context.input.total_cents >= 200000) };
